next_step: Infra deep-dive: confirm network topology, KMS plan, and provide a 1B-vector cost model + PO C SLOs by 2026-03-18
blockers: unknown peak QPS for reranker stage
notes: Target: massive-scale index. Initial pilot 250M vectors; plan to grow to 1B+ in 12-18 months.
Workload: semantic search fronted by dense embeddings + a cross-encoder reranker for top-100 results. Need low P95 latency for combined retrieval+rerank.
Latency targets: p50 ~20-40ms retrieval; p95 combined retrieval+rerank < 200ms (aggressive where possible).
Throughput: steady-state ingest of 5-10M new vectors/month; peak QPS for search estimated 2k-6k (still unknown, will validate in POC).
Cost sensitivity: strict. Unit cost target: <$0.002 per query including reranker OR ability to reach <$0.0005/query for embedding-only use cases via batching/caching/quantization.
Deployment preference: private/VPC for first 12 months due to PII regulatory concerns; open to Dedicated in cloud near-term. On-prem for EU customer data subset later.
Security: require SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logging, strict retention controls, KMS/HSM integration and per-region data residency. Legal asked for an architecture diagram before procurement.

Model preferences: high-quality dense embedder (instruction-tuned ok) + lightweight cross-encoder reranker (FP16 / quantized) for final ranking. Want recommendations on model/quantization tradeoffs from Redwood Optimize.
Caching/Batching: must support prefix/KV caching at top-K candidates, request batching for embedder-only queries, and autoscale burst capacity for heavy query windows.
Quote from CTO (paraphrased): 'We can trade some latency for 10x cost savings if output quality preserved — want clear knobs and telemetry.'
Commercial signal: exec sponsor in search infra; willing to consider 12-mo reserved capacity commit if price per-query targets and SLA met.
POC ask: ingest 10M sample docs, run embedding perf/accuracy bench vs. their current vector store, run reranker A/B on MRR/recall@10 and provide tokenized cost/perf breakdown.
Acceptance metrics for POC: recall@10 >= current baseline, MRR >= baseline+5%, combined p95 < 200ms for demo load, and a reproducible cost model for 250M/1B indexes.
Operational asks: tracing hooks (per-request latency breakdown), token-level cost dashboard, and per-model rollback/rollout windows in console.
Notes: engineering interested in transparent kernel selection and quantization profiles; opteam wants a template for DLP & network diagrams to share with legal.
Short term: gave pricing deck + security FAQ (links above). Awaiting Redwood infra deep-dive and 1B-vector cost runbook.
Misc: mentioned evaluating Milvus + elastic hybrid internally; cited Pinecone as baseline for ingestion ergonomics.
